affinity.notes: Faction, rank, and physical equipment drive the design without elemental effects.

anatomy.notes: The armored humanoid body, face, weapon arm, and banner hand read coherently.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "commander bruiser" semantically communicates Trial-of-Standards Tyrant (Sovereign) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: The raised standard signals command utility while the hooked cleaver signals close-range punishment.

finish.notes: Layered armor, cloth, bone, and metal details feel complete and consistent.

framing.notes: The full warlord, cleaver, and command standard are clearly presented.

identity.notes: Blind perception "armored orc warlord" semantically identifies orcs/orc-overlord.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "boss" is accepted for intended T5 under the documented v2 normalization.
